description: Update the session state shown at the top of each turn: the files, sessions, tasks and other things in play, the user's goals, and constraints already settled. Add what later messages may refer to ("that file", "the previous step"), and forget what no longer matters. The state is small and bounded; the oldest entries are dropped first. Returns the new state.
name: update_state

constraints.description: Constraints that are now settled, to add

entities.description: Things to add or update; an entity is identified by its kind and name

kind.description: file, session, task, branch, error, or another short word

name.description: The path, id or title the user would refer to it by

note.description: A few words on its role or status

goals.description: The user's current goals; replaces the earlier list
